title: AggregateWindowChangedPayload
description: Payload of the AggregateWindowChanged event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2853 (T9). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

entityRef.description: The registered entity the window belongs to.

periodRef.description: Prescribed period reference, when the window is period-aligned.

aggregateId.description: The aggregate identifier, present when state is CLOSED.
